args: until settings put global hide_error_dialogs 1; do sleep 1; done
name: 002-hide-os-dialogs

args: while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != "1" ]; do sleep 1; done; getprop sys.boot_completed
name: 003-boot

args: for attempt in 1 2 3; do settings put global window_animation_scale 0 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 1
name: 004-animation-window

args: for attempt in 1 2 3; do settings put global transition_animation_scale 0 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 1
name: 005-animation-transition

args: for attempt in 1 2 3; do settings put global animator_duration_scale 0 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 1
name: 006-animation-animator
